rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when amounts, expenses, or entitlements build up over time.

example.english: These expenses accrue so quickly lately that I really can't cope.
example.traditional: 呢排啲開支累積得好快，真係頂唔順。
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 di1 hoi1 zi1 leoi6 zik1 dak1 hou2 faai3 zan1 hai6 ding2 m4 seon6

rows.note: Use this when something arises as a result, especially when money lent produces interest.

example.english: The money I put in the bank will accrue interest every month.
example.traditional: 放喺銀行嗰筆錢每個月都會產生利息。
example.jyutping: fong3 hai2 ngan4 hong4 go2 bat1 cin4 mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 wui5 caan2 sang1 lei6 sik1

rows.note: Use this when a benefit accrues to a particular person, group, or area.

example.english: The benefits of this new measure will accrue to nearby residents.
example.traditional: 呢項新措施會令附近居民受惠。
example.jyutping: ne1 hong6 san1 cou3 si1 wui5 ling6 fu6 gan6 geoi1 man4 sau6 wai6
